title: ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI’s Dots agents make purchases for you

scenes.narration: Tech news you need to know. ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI’s Dots agents make purchases for you.
After launching its Dots AI agents platform earlier this year, OpenAI is launching a wallet for the agents.

ChatGPT Wallet is rolling out starting today for ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the US aged 18 and older using a US billing address and "eligible US-issued American Express, Chase, Mastercard and Visa cards." After adding a card […]
This story was reported by The Verge and TechCrunch.
